T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Greetings !
 
I am contacting you in regards to my late client Mason Barr who died in the Netherlands on the 16th of April 2020 as a result of respiratory infection.
My late client was never married and having known the truth I had no choice than to do what I think is lawful and right as a citizen of good conscience.
I am Keith Vernieri, personal attorney/sole executor to the late Mason from the United State of America who was working and shuffling in Amsterdam and London at the time of his death.

My late client grew up in Los Angeles with his beloved aunt Sally before she passed on but later moved to Amsterdam where we later met after law school, Mason was a kind soul who also made sure he assisted the less privileged around him.

My late client invested in the stock market and made his fortune from the Stock exchange market and also from construction, However sometime around march 2017 he deposited five million pounds (5,000,000.00) with Mozi finance company and I am a living witness to this claim because I worked with him for more than a decade and the reason why I am contacting you is because he was never married or had any children.

Since his death I have been devastated and left pondering on so many unresolved questions with my conscience and I have decided to take matters into my own hand and have his money released without any further delay from the bank.

However since the death of Mason, I have searched for Mason's extended relatives who shall be claimants/beneficiaries of this claim and all of my efforts have been unproductive because he was raised by Aunty Sally who is now dead.

Presently, this money is still with the bank and I have all the necessary documents to have the money released as long as I present a family member to apply for the claim and I will guide you and furnish you with whatever that may be required for the claim to go through.

Back to basics, I know you are presently pondering over my request but I want you to know that I will guide you through this procedure and cover all axes accurately regarding the law to avoid any hindrance.

I honestly do not expect you to believe me but all I have is just words and proof that will change our lives for good and help save an innocent man's wealth from getting liquidated by the bank in London. I am presently in Los Angeles, United States.

I will be willing to split the funds with you in this manner; 30% percent for me and 60% percent for you and 10% percent for any charity of your choice and I hope this is acceptable to you with all due respect.

I cannot live with the agony of entrusting this huge responsibility to myself alone and I need you to help me with this process and I will be here to direct and guide you.
 
 Lastly, I need your corporation so we can have this inheritance released from the bank. I will forward you more details as soon as I receive your response
My email address is kvern222@gmail.com

Yours Sincerely
Keith Vernieri LL.B (Hons)
Principal Attorney
Keith Vernieri Legal Advocates
kvern222@gmail.com
